Hello,

Thank you for reaching out — I appreciate being considered for the Software Engineer L4 role. Before I proceed, could you please confirm this is an official Google Careers contact and provide the application link on the official google.com careers site (careers.google.com) or an @google.com email address I can verify? I received a link in this message pointing to apply-to-google-jobs.com, which looks like a non-official domain, so I wanted to confirm before sharing any personal information.

I’m very interested and happy to provide my resume or schedule a time to speak once verified.

Thanks,
Jordan Mitchell
jordan.mitchell@email.com
+1 (512) 555-0147
